uncertainty.points: Ratios within outcome/reference-known domains, potentially different by field.
uncertainty.design_intervals: Existing approximate design intervals under exchangeable independently salted hash-order / stratified sampling assumptions. No independent variance recalculation in this release.
uncertainty.unknown_envelopes: Existing conservative full-target HT sensitivity summaries for unresolved outcomes/membership. Not CIs, not established sharp joint bounds and not combined sampling-plus-missingness intervals.
uncertainty.reference_quality: Relative to Pro judgments, not independent human gold; common semantic reference errors are not included in design intervals.
